The answer is C. The Open Door Notes (1899–1900), issued by US Secretary of State John Hay, asked the imperial powers to keep China open to trade on equal terms, so US commerce and missionaries wouldn't be shut out of their spheres of influence. The team note is wrong: the notes concerned trade access, not Chinese immigration into the US. In fact, the US was restricting Chinese immigration at the time, under the Chinese Exclusion Act.

CONFIDENCE: 90
